verdict.rationale: Meltano projects are initialized via CLI (meltano init), define plugins/config as YAML in the project directory, and docs explicitly state projects can be treated like any software project with version control, code review, and CI/CD; community evidence confirms production use (GitLab Data Team) and open-source code access. missing for 10: independent hands-on account specifically praising git-based review workflows beyond docs' own claim.
